root.name: Marienbad System
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. Nf3 b6 3. g3 Bb7 4. Bg2 c5

overview: Black sets up a Queen's Indian-style fianchetto with ...b6 and ...Bb7, then strikes at the centre with ...c5 against White's g3/Bg2 set-up. The game usually goes into a Hedgehog or open Sicilian-style structure with ...e6, ...cxd4 and ...Be7, where both sides have long diagonals.

white_ideas.idea: Fianchetto with g3, Bg2 and castle
Meet ...c5 with d5 or O-O and c4
Build pressure on the long diagonal and the d-file

black_ideas.idea: Use the b7 bishop on the long diagonal
Set up a hedgehog with ...e6, ...d6 and ...Be7

typical_structures.structure: Hedgehog-style pawns on a6, b6, d6, e6

character.notes: A flexible fianchetto game with few forced lines.

gambit.notes: No material is given up in the main line.

structure.notes: The centre may open with ...cxd4 or remain flexible with d5.

approach.notes: A Black set-up played against many White tries.

character.reason: Neither side takes big risks and play is positional.

structure.reason: The centre is not fixed and may open or close.

approach.reason: Recognised in the Queen's Indian family, not a universal system.

level.reason: Plans matter, with little to memorise.

plans.reason: Both sides fianchetto and challenge the centre with pieces.
